# Vendored libraries

Offline copies, no CDN, matching this ecosystem's `preview.nvim`/`cartograph.nvim`
convention of not requiring network access to render the UI.

- `cytoscape.min.js` — [Cytoscape.js](https://js.cytoscape.org/), MIT License, © The Cytoscape Consortium
- `dagre.min.js` — [dagre](https://github.com/dagrejs/dagre), MIT License, © Chris Pettitt
- `cytoscape-dagre.min.js` — [cytoscape.js-dagre](https://github.com/cytoscape/cytoscape.js-dagre), MIT License

Copied from `cartograph.nvim`'s own vendored copies (same libraries, same license terms).
